reviewer: Codex, manual qualitative review; no independent or blinded second reviewer
definition: Flag histories with at least one explicit between-session task marked completed despite a spoken report of non-completion or partial completion. Completed review/attempt labels are treated as ambiguous and excluded. This is a targeted error audit, not overall extraction accuracy.
